scope: Independent local source/delta and retained diagnostic evidence review; no operator execution, imports, tests, cloud, auth, database, journal or provider actions by reviewer.
sourceFindings: Both dispatcher and inner admit plan mode only; the entire executable owner.bind and budget-install branch is removed. Remaining imported install symbol is unused.
The same immutable source-owned inventory, manifest, hydration, qualification and binding inspection owners remain; inventory captureAuthority:false is not promoted into qualification authority.
Inspection uses existing tenant/user transaction scoping and row locks. This is business-data read-only, not a claim of PostgreSQL SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY or no cloud resource registration.
New exclusive output paths, original failed result hash/status/cleanup pins, exact image/template/source/rates and one-attempt dispatch/cleanup fences remain.

Actual emitted diagnostics retain allowlisted class/code, bounded application stack frames, message hash and type-only assertion metadata. No raw message, SQL, Prisma meta, actual or expected assertion value is emitted by the new diagnostic payload.

observedResult.stackInterpretation: The retained stack places this diagnostic failure in readSyntheticCorrectionRetirementInTx, called by previous fixture hydrateInTx during the canonical source qualifier.
observedResult.receiptJoin: Exact retained JSONL bytes/hash/event sequence equal the result and transport records; no wrapper failures; exit 1 is retained rather than reclassified as PLAN_ONLY.

correction.priorStatement: Earlier conversational wording said the prior plan-v2 failure was during owner.inspect.
correction.correctedStatement: The prior plan-v2 receipt proves only the broad INSPECT stage, which also includes later saved-state and hash/assertion checks. The new diagnostic precisely locates its own P2028 failure; it does not conclusively establish the identical exact substep for the prior attempt.

limits: Diagnostic failed and does not qualify a successful setup plan, binding, budget installation, journal adoption or capture.
No database audit or rerun by reviewer; no additional lifecycle assertions are inferred from absence of a write path.
Any timeout repair and subsequent actual successful plan require separate exact-source and evidence review before setup execution.
